newsitem.title: USA: U.S. jet fuel diffs inch higher in thin action.
newsitem.headline: U.S. jet fuel diffs inch higher in thin action.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel differentials firmed in modest trading Tuesday, as players awaited the arrival of the weekly inventory data.
On the NYMEX, September heating oil futures fell a modest 0.12 cent to settle at 58.32 cents a gallon.
Prompt 54-grade jet fuel traded in the U.S. Gulf at 0.60 cent over the September NYMEX, about 0.20 cent stronger than late Monday levels, although players said activity was very subdued.
New York Harbor prompt 54-grade jet fuel traded at 3.25 cents over the September futures, up slightly from the previous day.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1620
